verses.original: כִּי֩ יְרַחֵ֨ם יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וּבָחַ֥ר עוֹד֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְנִלְוָ֤ה הַגֵּר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְנִסְפְּח֖וּ עַל־ בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî yə·ra·ḥêm Yah·weh ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·ḇā·ḥar ‘ō·wḏ bə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·hin·nî·ḥām ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām wə·nil·wāh hag·gêr ‘ă·lê·hem wə·nis·pə·ḥū ‘al- bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob once again He will choose Israel and settle them in their own land The foreigner will join them and unite . . . with the house of Jacob

verses.original: וּלְקָח֣וּם עַמִּים֮ וֶהֱבִיא֣וּם אֶל־ מְקוֹמָם֒ וְהִֽתְנַחֲל֣וּם בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲבָדִ֖ים וְלִשְׁפָח֑וֹת וְהָיוּ֙ שֹׁבִ֣ים לְשֹֽׁבֵיהֶ֔ם וְרָד֖וּ בְּנֹגְשֵׂיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·qā·ḥūm ‘am·mîm we·hĕ·ḇî·’ūm ’el- mə·qō·w·mām wə·hiṯ·na·ḥă·lūm bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al ’aḏ·maṯ Yah·weh la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·liš·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ wə·hā·yū šō·ḇîm lə·šō·ḇê·hem wə·rā·ḏū bə·nō·ḡə·śê·hem
verses.literal: The nations will escort Israel and bring it to its homeland Then the house of Israel will possess the nations as menservants and maidservants in the LORD’s land They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּי֨וֹם הָנִ֤יחַ יְהוָה֙ לְךָ֔ מֵֽעָצְבְּךָ֖ וּמֵרָגְזֶ֑ךָ וּמִן־ הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַקָּשָׁ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֻבַּד־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·yō·wm hā·nî·aḥ Yah·weh lə·ḵā mê·‘ā·ṣə·bə·ḵā ū·mê·rā·ḡə·ze·ḵā ū·min- hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh haq·qā·šāh ’ă·šer ‘ub·baḏ- bāḵ
verses.literal: On the day that the LORD gives you rest . . . from your pain and torment and from the hard labor into which you were forced

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֜אתָ הַמָּשָׁ֥ל הַזֶּ֛ה עַל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְאָמָ֑רְתָּ אֵ֚יךְ שָׁבַ֣ת נֹגֵ֔שׂ שָׁבְתָ֖ה מַדְהֵבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śā·ṯā ham·mā·šāl haz·zeh ‘al- me·leḵ bā·ḇel wə·’ā·mā·rə·tā ’êḵ šā·ḇaṯ nō·ḡêś šā·ḇə·ṯāh maḏ·hê·ḇāh
verses.literal: you will sing this song of contempt against the king of Babylon How the oppressor has ceased and how his fury has ended

verses.original: שָׁבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה מַטֵּ֣ה רְשָׁעִ֑ים שֵׁ֖בֶט מֹשְׁלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ḇar Yah·weh maṭ·ṭêh rə·šā·‘îm šê·ḇeṭ mō·šə·lîm
verses.literal: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked the scepter of the rulers

verses.original: מַכֶּ֤ה עַמִּים֙ בְּעֶבְרָ֔ה מַכַּ֖ת בִּלְתִּ֣י סָרָ֑ה רֹדֶ֤ה בָאַף֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם מֻרְדָּ֖ף בְּלִ֥י חָשָֽׂךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mak·keh ‘am·mîm bə·‘eḇ·rāh mak·kaṯ bil·tî sā·rāh rō·ḏeh ḇā·’ap̄ gō·w·yim mur·dāp̄ bə·lî ḥā·śāḵ
verses.literal: It struck the peoples in anger with unceasing . . . blows it subdued the nations in rage with relentless . . . persecution

verses.original: נָ֥חָה שָׁקְטָ֖ה כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ פָּצְח֖וּ רִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḥāh šā·qə·ṭāh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ pā·ṣə·ḥū rin·nāh
verses.literal: All the earth is at peace and at rest they break out in song

verses.original: גַּם־ בְּרוֹשִׁ֛ים שָׂמְח֥וּ לְךָ֖ אַרְזֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן מֵאָ֣ז שָׁכַ֔בְתָּ לֹֽא־ יַעֲלֶ֥ה הַכֹּרֵ֖ת עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- bə·rō·wō·šîm śā·mə·ḥū lə·ḵā ’ar·zê lə·ḇā·nō·wn mê·’āz šā·ḵaḇ·tā lō- ya·‘ă·leh hak·kō·rêṯ ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: Even the cypresses and cedars of Lebanon exult over you Since you have been laid low no woodcutter comes against us

verses.original: שְׁא֗וֹל מִתַּ֛חַת רָגְזָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לִקְרַ֣את בּוֹאֶ֑ךָ עוֹרֵ֨ר לְךָ֤ רְפָאִים֙ כָּל־ עַתּ֣וּדֵי אָ֔רֶץ הֵקִים֙ מִכִּסְאוֹתָ֔ם כֹּ֖ל מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·’ō·wl mit·ta·ḥaṯ rā·ḡə·zāh lə·ḵā liq·raṯ bō·w·’e·ḵā ‘ō·w·rêr lə·ḵā rə·p̄ā·’îm kāl- ‘at·tū·ḏê ’ā·reṣ hê·qîm mik·kis·’ō·w·ṯām kōl mal·ḵê ḡō·w·yim
verses.literal: Sheol beneath is eager to meet you upon your arrival It stirs the spirits of the dead to greet you all the rulers of the earth It makes all the kings of the nations rise from their thrones

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֣ם יַֽעֲנ֔וּ וְיֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ גַּם־ אַתָּ֛ה חֻלֵּ֥יתָ כָמ֖וֹנוּ אֵלֵ֥ינוּ נִמְשָֽׁלְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām ya·‘ă·nū wə·yō·mə·rū ’ê·le·ḵā gam- ’at·tāh ḥul·lê·ṯā ḵā·mō·w·nū ’ê·lê·nū nim·šā·lə·tā
verses.literal: They will all respond to you saying You too have become weak as we are you have become like us

verses.original: הוּרַ֥ד שְׁא֛וֹל גְּאוֹנֶ֖ךָ הֶמְיַ֣ת נְבָלֶ֑יךָ תַּחְתֶּ֙יךָ֙ יֻצַּ֣ע רִמָּ֔ה וּמְכַסֶּ֖יךָ תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hū·raḏ šə·’ō·wl ḡə·’ō·w·ne·ḵā hem·yaṯ nə·ḇā·le·ḵā taḥ·te·ḵā yuṣ·ṣa‘ rim·māh ū·mə·ḵas·se·ḵā tō·w·lê·‘āh
verses.literal: Your pomp has been brought down to Sheol along with the music of your harps Maggots are your bed . . . and worms your blanket

verses.original: אֵ֛יךְ נָפַ֥לְתָּ מִשָּׁמַ֖יִם הֵילֵ֣ל בֶּן־ שָׁ֑חַר נִגְדַּ֣עְתָּ לָאָ֔רֶץ חוֹלֵ֖שׁ עַל־ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êḵ nā·p̄al·tā miš·šā·ma·yim hê·lêl ben- šā·ḥar niḡ·da‘·tā lā·’ā·reṣ ḥō·w·lêš ‘al- gō·w·yim
verses.literal: How you have fallen from heaven O day star son of the dawn You have been cut down to the ground O destroyer of nations

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ בִֽלְבָבְךָ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֶֽעֱלֶ֔ה מִמַּ֥עַל לְכֽוֹכְבֵי־ אֵ֖ל אָרִ֣ים כִּסְאִ֑י וְאֵשֵׁ֥ב בְּהַר־ מוֹעֵ֖ד בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ā·mar·tā ḇil·ḇā·ḇə·ḵā haš·šā·ma·yim ’e·‘ĕ·leh mim·ma·‘al lə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê- ’êl ’ā·rîm kis·’î wə·’ê·šêḇ bə·har- mō·w·‘êḏ bə·yar·kə·ṯê ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: You said in your heart I will ascend to the heavens I will raise my throne above the stars of God I will sit on the mount of assembly in the far reaches of the north

verses.original: אֶעֱלֶ֖ה עַל־ בָּ֣מֳתֵי עָ֑ב אֶדַּמֶּ֖ה לְעֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·‘ĕ·leh ‘al- bā·mo·ṯê ‘āḇ ’ed·dam·meh lə·‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds I will make myself like the Most High

verses.original: אַ֧ךְ אֶל־ שְׁא֛וֹל תּוּרָ֖ד אֶל־ יַרְכְּתֵי־ בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’el- šə·’ō·wl tū·rāḏ ’el- yar·kə·ṯê- ḇō·wr
verses.literal: But you will be brought down to Sheol to the lowest depths of the Pit

verses.original: רֹאֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵלֶ֣יךָ יַשְׁגִּ֔יחוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ יִתְבּוֹנָ֑נוּ הֲזֶ֤ה הָאִישׁ֙ מַרְגִּ֣יז הָאָ֔רֶץ מַרְעִ֖ישׁ מַמְלָכֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: rō·’e·ḵā ’ê·le·ḵā yaš·gî·ḥū ’ê·le·ḵā yiṯ·bō·w·nā·nū hă·zeh hā·’îš mar·gîz hā·’ā·reṣ mar·‘îš mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: Those who see you will stare they will ponder your fate Is this the man who shook the earth and made the kingdoms tremble

verses.original: שָׂ֥ם תֵּבֵ֛ל כַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְעָרָ֣יו הָרָ֑ס אֲסִירָ֖יו לֹא־ פָ֥תַח בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: śām tê·ḇêl kam·miḏ·bār wə·‘ā·rāw hā·rās ’ă·sî·rāw lō- p̄ā·ṯaḥ bā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: who turned the world into a desert and destroyed its cities who refused to let the captives return to their homes

verses.original: כָּל־ מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם שָׁכְב֥וּ בְכָב֖וֹד אִ֥ישׁ בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mal·ḵê ḡō·w·yim kul·lām šā·ḵə·ḇū ḇə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ’îš bə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: All the kings of the nations . . . lie in state each in his own tomb

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה הָשְׁלַ֤כְתָּ מִֽקִּבְרְךָ֙ כְּנֵ֣צֶר נִתְעָ֔ב לְב֥וּשׁ הֲרֻגִ֖ים מְטֹ֣עֲנֵי חָ֑רֶב יוֹרְדֵ֥י אֶל־ אַבְנֵי־ ב֖וֹר כְּפֶ֥גֶר מוּבָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh hā·šə·laḵ·tā miq·qiḇ·rə·ḵā kə·nê·ṣer niṯ·‘āḇ lə·ḇūš hă·ru·ḡîm mə·ṭō·‘ă·nê ḥā·reḇ yō·wr·ḏê ’el- ’aḇ·nê- ḇō·wr kə·p̄e·ḡer mū·ḇās
verses.literal: But you are cast out of your grave like a rejected branch covered by those slain . . . with the sword and dumped into a rocky pit like a carcass trampled underfoot

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תֵחַ֤ד אִתָּם֙ בִּקְבוּרָ֔ה כִּֽי־ אַרְצְךָ֥ שִׁחַ֖תָּ עַמְּךָ֣ הָרָ֑גְתָּ לֹֽא־ יִקָּרֵ֥א לְעוֹלָ֖ם זֶ֥רַע מְרֵעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯê·ḥaḏ ’it·tām biq·ḇū·rāh kî- ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ši·ḥa·tā ‘am·mə·ḵā hā·rā·ḡə·tā lō- yiq·qā·rê lə·‘ō·w·lām ze·ra‘ mə·rê·‘îm
verses.literal: You will not join them . . . in burial since you have destroyed your land and slaughtered your own people The offspring of the wicked will never again . . . be mentioned

verses.original: הָכִ֧ינוּ לְבָנָ֛יו מַטְבֵּ֖חַ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן אֲבוֹתָ֑ם בַּל־ יָקֻ֙מוּ֙ וְיָ֣רְשׁוּ אָ֔רֶץ וּמָלְא֥וּ פְנֵֽי־ תֵבֵ֖ל עָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḵî·nū lə·ḇā·nāw maṭ·bê·aḥ ba·‘ă·wōn ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām bal- yā·qu·mū wə·yā·rə·šū ’ā·reṣ ū·mā·lə·’ū p̄ə·nê- ṯê·ḇêl ‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: Prepare a place to slaughter his sons for the iniquities of their forefathers They will never rise up to possess a land or cover the earth with their cities

verses.original: וְקַמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְהִכְרַתִּ֨י לְבָבֶ֜ל שֵׁ֥ם וּשְׁאָ֛ר וְנִ֥ין וָנֶ֖כֶד נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qam·tî ‘ă·lê·hem nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî lə·ḇā·ḇel šêm ū·šə·’ār wə·nîn wā·ne·ḵeḏ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will rise up against them declares the LORD of Hosts I will cut off from Babylon her name and her remnant her offspring and her posterity declares the LORD

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֛יהָ לְמוֹרַ֥שׁ קִפֹּ֖ד וְאַגְמֵי־ מָ֑יִם וְטֵֽאטֵאתִ֙יהָ֙ בְּמַטְאֲטֵ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֔ד נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî·hā lə·mō·w·raš qip·pōḏ wə·’aḡ·mê- mā·yim wə·ṭê·ṭê·ṯî·hā bə·maṭ·’ă·ṭê haš·mêḏ nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will make her a place for owls and for swamplands . . . I will sweep her away with the broom of destruction declares the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־ לֹ֞א כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּמִּ֙יתִי֙ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֔תָה וְכַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יָעַ֖צְתִּי הִ֥יא תָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: niš·ba‘ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lê·mōr ’im- lō ka·’ă·šer dim·mî·ṯî kên hā·yā·ṯāh wə·ḵa·’ă·šer yā·‘aṣ·tî hî ṯā·qūm
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts . . . has sworn Surely . . . as I have planned so will it be as I have purposed . . . so will it stand

verses.original: לִשְׁבֹּ֤ר אַשּׁוּר֙ בְּאַרְצִ֔י וְעַל־ הָרַ֖י אֲבוּסֶ֑נּוּ וְסָ֤ר מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם֙ עֻלּ֔וֹ וְסֻ֨בֳּל֔וֹ מֵעַ֥ל שִׁכְמ֖וֹ יָסֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: liš·bōr ’aš·šūr bə·’ar·ṣî wə·‘al- hā·ray ’ă·ḇū·sen·nū wə·sār mê·‘ă·lê·hem ‘ul·lōw wə·sub·bo·lōw mê·‘al šiḵ·mōw yā·sūr
verses.literal: I will break Assyria in My land I will trample him on My mountain His yoke will be taken off My people and his burden removed from their shoulders

verses.original: זֹ֛את הָעֵצָ֥ה הַיְּעוּצָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְזֹ֛את הַיָּ֥ד הַנְּטוּיָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hā·‘ê·ṣāh hay·yə·‘ū·ṣāh ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·zōṯ hay·yāḏ han·nə·ṭū·yāh ‘al- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: This is the plan devised for the whole earth and this is the hand stretched out over all the nations

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יָעָ֖ץ וּמִ֣י יָפֵ֑ר וְיָד֥וֹ הַנְּטוּיָ֖ה וּֽמִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yā·‘āṣ ū·mî yā·p̄êr wə·yā·ḏōw han·nə·ṭū·yāh ū·mî yə·šî·ḇen·nāh
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts has purposed and who can thwart Him His hand is outstretched so who can turn it back

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַת־ מ֖וֹת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֑ז הָיָ֖ה הַמַּשָּׂ֥א הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ- mō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz hā·yāh ham·maś·śā haz·zeh
verses.literal: In the year that King Ahaz died this burden was received

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י פְלֶ֙שֶׁת֙ כֻּלֵּ֔ךְ כִּ֥י נִשְׁבַּ֖ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַכֵּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ מִשֹּׁ֤רֶשׁ נָחָשׁ֙ יֵ֣צֵא צֶ֔פַע וּפִרְי֖וֹ שָׂרָ֥ף מְעוֹפֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiś·mə·ḥî p̄ə·le·šeṯ kul·lêḵ kî niš·bar šê·ḇeṭ mak·kêḵ kî- miš·šō·reš nā·ḥāš yê·ṣê ṣe·p̄a‘ ū·p̄ir·yōw śā·rāp̄ mə·‘ō·w·p̄êp̄
verses.literal: Do not rejoice all you Philistines that the rod that struck you is broken For a viper will spring from the root of the snake and a flying serpent from its egg

verses.original: וְרָעוּ֙ בְּכוֹרֵ֣י דַלִּ֔ים וְאֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים לָבֶ֣טַח יִרְבָּ֑צוּ וְהֵמַתִּ֤י בָֽרָעָב֙ שָׁרְשֵׁ֔ךְ וּשְׁאֵרִיתֵ֖ךְ יַהֲרֹֽג׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·‘ū bə·ḵō·w·rê ḏal·lîm wə·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ yir·bā·ṣū wə·hê·mat·tî ḇā·rā·‘āḇ šā·rə·šêḵ ū·šə·’ê·rî·ṯêḵ ya·hă·rōḡ
verses.literal: Then the firstborn of the poor will find pasture and the needy will lie down in safety but I will kill your root by famine and your remnant will be slain

verses.original: הֵילִ֤ילִֽי שַׁ֙עַר֙ זַֽעֲקִי־ עִ֔יר נָמ֖וֹג פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת כֻּלֵּ֑ךְ כִּ֤י מִצָּפוֹן֙ עָשָׁ֣ן בָּ֔א וְאֵ֥ין בּוֹדֵ֖ד בְּמוֹעָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hê·lî·lî ša·‘ar za·‘ă·qî- ‘îr nā·mō·wḡ pə·le·šeṯ kul·lêḵ kî miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ‘ā·šān bā wə·’ên bō·w·ḏêḏ bə·mō·w·‘ā·ḏāw
verses.literal: Wail O gate Cry out O city Melt away all you Philistines For a cloud of smoke comes from the north and there are no stragglers in its ranks

verses.original: וּמַֽה־ יַּעֲנֶ֖ה מַלְאֲכֵי־ ג֑וֹי כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יִסַּ֣ד צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָ֥הּ יֶחֱס֖וּ עֲנִיֵּ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mah- ya·‘ă·neh mal·’ă·ḵê- ḡō·w kî Yah·weh yis·saḏ ṣî·yō·wn ū·ḇāh ye·ḥĕ·sū ‘ă·nî·yê ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: What answer will be given to the envoys of that nation . . . The LORD has founded Zion where His afflicted people will find refuge
